instruction: Walk up the flight of stairs to the top. Turn and follow the railing into the bedroom area. Walk towards the closet.

steps.thought: The staircase is visible on the right side of the frame. I need to turn right to face the stairs and then climb them.
I'm facing a wall at the base of the stairs; the stairs ascend to my right. I'll turn right to face the staircase and start climbing.
I'm facing a wall with stairs visible to the right. I need to turn right toward the stairs and climb up.
I'm facing a wall with stairs visible to my right; I need to turn toward the stairs and climb.
I'm at the top of the stairs with the railing ahead. I'll turn left to follow the railing toward the bedroom area.
I'm at the top of the stairs with a bedroom visible through the doorway ahead-left. I'll walk toward it.
I'm at the top of the stairs; the bedroom is visible through the doorway on the left. I'll turn left and walk toward it, then look for the closet.
I'm in the upstairs hallway with the bedroom visible through the open doorway ahead. I'll walk toward it to find the closet.
I'm in an upstairs hallway with a bedroom visible ahead through the doorway. I'll advance toward it.
I'm facing a blank wall; the hallway with the bedroom is to my left. I'll turn left to reorient.
I'm facing a blank wall; the hallway with doors extends to my left. I'll turn left to face down the hallway and look for the bedroom/closet.
I'm facing a wall of closet doors; the bedroom is visible through the doorway on the left. I'll turn left and move toward it.
I'm at the top of the stairs on the upper landing; the closet doors are on the right wall and the bedroom is ahead. I'll move forward toward the closet doors.
I'm in the upstairs hallway facing the bedroom doorway; the closet doors are on the right. I'll advance through the doorway toward the bedroom.
I'm at the bedroom doorway; the closet doors are on the right wall. I'll enter the room and approach the closet area.
I'm now inside the bedroom. The closet is likely along the right wall near the open door; I'll advance into the room and look for it.
I'm inside the bedroom now; the closet is likely through the doorway ahead near the chair. I'll advance toward it.
I'm in the bedroom area; there's an opening in the wall ahead that may lead to the closet. I'll move forward through it and re-observe.
I'm in the bedroom area but facing a wall close-up. I need to turn to view the room and locate the closet.
I'm in the bedroom area near a chaise and bed, but no closet is visible yet. I'll turn left to scan the room for the closet.
I'm in the bedroom facing the bed; the closet is likely near the doorway behind me. I'll turn around to locate it.
I'm in the bedroom facing a wall/pillar. The closet is likely elsewhere in the room; I should turn left to scan the room interior.
I'm in the bedroom area now, but I don't see a closet in the current view. I'll turn right to scan the room for the closet.
I'm in the bedroom near the bed and window. The closet isn't visible; I should turn left to scan the room for it.
I'm in the bedroom facing a chaise and window; the closet isn't visible yet. I'll turn right to scan the room for the closet area.
Through the doorway on the right I can see a closet with hanging clothes. I'll turn right and approach it.
The closet with white shelving is visible through the doorway ahead. I'll advance toward it.
I'm at the closet entrance with shelves visible ahead; I'll step inside toward the closet and stop.
